title: Product-specific FDA REMS requirements
rule_summary: A pharmacy dispensing a drug subject to an FDA REMS must follow the current product-specific certification, authorization, documentation, and safe-use requirements that apply to the dispenser.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply rems requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing rems with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
